description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for the month of January 2015 was 183.2
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index for January 2015, which is a statistical economic indicator published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). As it concerns economic statistics rather than administrative changes, it falls under Miscellaneous gazettes.
